intent: Ingest an incoming request through a nested pipeline: prefilter it to drop noise, then hand the real requests to the support ticket router as a sub workflow, then audit whether a human needs to double-check the routing outcome before acting.

known_steps.text: the workflow runs at most 30 iterations
a choice question "is_noise" asks "Is this message noise that should be dropped before routing?"
a choice question "needs_human" asks "Given the routing outcome, does a human need to double-check it?"
label "AUDIT_REQUIRED" when the answer is "B" with at least 0.5 confidence

unknown_steps.text: a nested pipeline with the sub workflow "support_ticket_router"
the answer "A" routes to the node "intake"
set the label "AUDIT_REQUIRED" when the answer is "B"
for any other answer go to "STOP"
